command: cd /work && rg --files -g 'Cargo.toml' -g '*rustfmt*' -g '*clippy*' -g '*rust-toolchain*' -g 'CONTRIBUTING*' -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'CLAUDE.md' -g 'AI_POLICY.md' crate && cat crate/Cargo.toml && cat crate/pulldown-cmark/Cargo.toml && cat skill/references/audit-checklist.md && cat skill/references/unsafe.md && cat skill/references/errors.md

cd /work && find crate -type f \( -name Cargo.toml -o -iname '*rustfmt*' -o -iname '*clippy*' -o -iname '*rust-toolchain*' -o -name 'CONTRIBUTING*' -o -name AGENTS.md -o -name CLAUDE.md -o -name AI_POLICY.md \) -print && cat crate/Cargo.toml crate/pulldown-cmark/Cargo.toml skill/references/audit-checklist.md skill/references/unsafe.md skill/references/errors.md
cd /work && cat crate/CONTRIBUTING.md && find crate/pulldown-cmark/src -type f -maxdepth 3 && cat skill/scripts/check.sh

cd /work && ./run python3 -I /work/skill/scripts/audit_scan.py /work/crate > /work/tmp/scan.log && cat crate/README.md && sed -n '1,260p' crate/pulldown-cmark/src/strings.rs && sed -n '1,240p' crate/pulldown-cmark/src/tree.rs

cd /work && tail -100 tmp/gate.log && cat tmp/scan.log && wc -l crate/pulldown-cmark/src/*.rs && grep -nE 'unsafe|pub (fn|struct|enum|trait)|fn (scan|parse|handle)' crate/pulldown-cmark/src/{lib,parse,firstpass,scanners,html,utils}.rs

cd /work && ./run sh -c 'cd /work/crate && cargo test --locked -p pulldown-cmark > /work/tmp/tests.log 2>&1 && cargo clippy --locked -p pulldown-cmark --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings > /work/tmp/clippy.log 2>&1; RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --locked -p pulldown-cmark --no-deps --document-private-items --all-features > /work/tmp/doc.log 2>&1; cargo clippy --locked -p pulldown-cmark --lib --bins --all-features -- -W missing_docs -W missing_debug_implementations -W clippy::missing_errors_doc -W clippy::missing_panics_doc -W clippy::undocumented_unsafe_blocks -W clippy::unwrap_used -W clippy::allow_attributes_without_reason -W clippy::missing_assert_message > /work/tmp/advisory.log 2>&1'

cd /work && sed -n '1,260p' crate/pulldown-cmark/src/lib.rs && sed -n '490,745p' crate/pulldown-cmark/src/lib.rs && cat crate/pulldown-cmark/src/utils.rs && cat crate/pulldown-cmark/src/linklabel.rs && cat tmp/clippy.log tmp/doc.log && tail -30 tmp/tests.log && grep -nE '^warning:|^ *--> ' tmp/advisory.log && grep -nE 'unsafe|pub fn|pub struct|pub trait|pub enum' crate/pulldown-cmark/src/*.rs

cd /work && cat crate/pulldown-cmark/src/html.rs && sed -n '180,350p' crate/pulldown-cmark/src/parse.rs && sed -n '2150,2400p' crate/pulldown-cmark/src/parse.rs && cat crate/pulldown-cmark/src/utils.rs && cat crate/pulldown-cmark/src/linklabel.rs
